column1: # The sweep of the scripts that can reach a real kubectl, helm, kind, k3d, docker or the installers (issue #212). One row for each script found by hack/ci/live-sweep-test.sh.
# Columns (tab separated): path, class, opt-in environment, name of the CI context variable, arguments, note.
#   guard   live; refuses a context that is not a named throwaway cluster (the shared helper hack/ci/lib/require-ci-context.sh or an own guard); the sweep test runs it
#           with fake tools and expects exit 2 and nothing but a read of the current context
#   own     live, but on a kind cluster that it makes itself with a kubeconfig of its own: it cannot reach the current context (checked by the sweep test)
#   user    a tool for a person's own cluster, by design; it has its own rules
#   docker  runs docker only (images, throwaway containers); no cluster
#   pending a live script whose guard another pull request adds; the sweep test names it and skips it
#   offline fakes, fixtures or no cluster call
# A script that is found and is not in this file fails the sweep test; a row of class guard without a guard fails it too.
